results.title: Supreme Court seeks answers from Delhi, neighbouring States on vehicular pollution
results.content: The Supreme Court seeks responses from Delhi and neighbouring States over vehicular emissions contributing to Delhi’s worsening air pollution. The court has raised concerns over vehicle-related pollution and questioned what steps are being taken to tackle the capital’s deteriorating air quality.
